호프는 제79회 칸 국제영화제 경쟁 부문 초청, 5월 17일 월드 프리미어 최초 상영 확정이 되었습니다.

🏆 출연진 라인업

📍 The Incident

During the promotional tour for *Avengers: Age of Ultron* in 2015, an interview with Krishnan Guru-Murthy of Channel 4 in the UK began warmly with discussions about the movie...

However, the interviewer suddenly started throwing extremely personal and sensitive questions completely unrelated to the film, such as Downey Jr.'s dark past (*his struggles with drug and alcohol addiction*) and his relationship with his father.

Downey Jr. tried to brush it off humorously by asking, "We are promoting our movie right now, right?" but due to the persistent rude questions, he eventually stormed out. 🚪💥

.

.

.
